# Emirates Park Zoo and Resort

> A comprehensive Abu Dhabi zoo and resort destination featuring diverse animal exhibits, interactive wildlife experiences, and premium accommodations with conservation and education at its core.

Emirates Park Zoo and Resort is a major Abu Dhabi attraction offering visitors access to hundreds of animal species across multiple exhibits, combined with a full-service resort, dining, and entertainment facilities. The venue emphasizes animal welfare, interactive learning, and family-friendly experiences.

## Getting Started

- [Emirates Park Zoo And Resort | Official Website](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com): Official homepage showcasing Emirates Park Zoo & Resort attractions and experiences
- [Tickets - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/ticket): Book tickets and admission for Emirates Park Zoo & Resort in Abu Dhabi

## Animal Exhibits

- [Mammals - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/carnivores-animals): Mammal exhibits including African lions and other carnivores at the zoo
- [Birds - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/birds): Bird exhibits including yellow-headed Amazons and other avian species
- [Reptiles - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/reptiles): Reptile exhibits showcasing Nile crocodiles and other reptile species
- [Domestic Animals - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/domestic-animals): Domestic animal exhibits featuring Arabian camels and other domestic species
- [Amphibians - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/amphibians): Amphibian exhibits featuring Arabian toads and other amphibian species
- [Fish - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/aquatic-world): Aquatic world exhibits featuring Oscar fish and other aquarium species

## Experiences & Activities

- [VIP EXPERIENCES - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/vip): Premium VIP experiences including giraffe breakfast and exclusive packages
- [Zoo Activities - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/zoo-activities): Overview of zoo activities and attractions featuring giraffe encounters
- [Animal Feeding - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/animal-feeding): Animal feeding experiences allowing guests to feed giraffes and wildlife
- [Animal Riding Adventure - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/animal-riding): Animal ride experiences with camels, ponies, and horses for families
- [Animal Presentations - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/animal-presentations): Live animal presentations and demonstrations featuring sea lions
- [Interactive sessions - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/interactive-sessions): Interactive animal talks and conservation education sessions
- [Fun Activities - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/fun-activities): Fun games zone with rides, arcade games, and interactive entertainment

## Education & Conservation

- [Education - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/educational-experiences): Educational programs and school trip packages with interactive learning
- [Animal Enrichment - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/animal-enrichment): Information on animal enrichment programs and welfare initiatives
- [Sustainability - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/Sustainability): Sustainability initiatives and conservation efforts at the resort

## Accommodations & Dining

- [Emirates Park Resort - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/resort): Resort accommodations with direct access to Emirates Park Zoo
- [Eat - Emirates Park Zoo and Resort](https://emiratesparkzooandresort.com/eat): Dining facilities including The Hide restaurant with international cuisine
